outcome: perinatal death (death at >= 20 weeks to <= 7 days)
maternal prolonged length of hospital stay (LOS > 3 days)
cohort: The study included 117,779 primiparous women with in-state singleton vaginal deliveries and adequate prenatal care, classified as ART-treated, subfertile, or fertile.
finding: ART-treated and subfertile women had higher odds of prematurity and low birthweight, and subfertile women also had higher odds of perinatal death, compared to fertile women in singleton vaginal deliveries.
